name: Inspect Evals
summary: Community collection of ready-to-run evaluation tasks for the UK AISI Inspect AI framework.
description: MIT-licensed eval suite (UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals; not archived). PyPI inspect-evals 0.28.0 and docs https://ukgovernmentbeis.github.io/inspect_evals/ verified 2026-11-09. Install alongside Inspect AI; individual benchmark datasets and any model APIs retain their own terms and costs. Established companion to Inspect, not marketed here as a brand-new product launch.

agent_access.notes: pip install inspect-evals; requires Inspect AI. Model credentials depend on chosen tasks.
